title: Are Scaling Laws of Universal MLIPs Universal?
abstract: arXiv:2611.15603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural scaling laws enable the prediction of returns from larger training datasets, but machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) datasets are heterogeneous and expensive to generate, and equal numbers of structures need not contain equal amounts of useful information. We study data scaling under fixed model configurations for M3GNet, MACE, and PET trained on subsets of a combined MatPES-MP-ALOE training pool. Across training structure subsets from 10,000 to 640,000, together with the full 1.16-million-structure training set, we compare uniform random sampling, three chemistry- and structure-informed stratification policies, iterative DIRECT, and furthest-point sampling using embeddings from three pretrained MLIPs. Models are evaluated using cohesive-energy, force, stress, and aggregate losses on both a held-out test set from the parent distribution and the distribution shifted MP-r$^2$SCAN test set. translated_title: 通用机器学习原子间势的缩放定律是普适的吗？
translated_abstract: 神经缩放定律能够预测更大训练数据集所带来的收益，但机器学习原子间势（MLIP）数据集具有异构性且生成成本高昂，相同数量的结构未必包含等量的有用信息。我们在固定模型配置下研究了M3GNet、MACE和PET的数据缩放行为，其训练数据来自MatPES-MP-ALOE组合训练池的子集。在从10,000到640,000的训练结构子集以及完整的116万结构训练集上，我们比较了均匀随机采样、三种基于化学与结构信息的分层策略、迭代式DIRECT方法，以及基于三个预训练MLIP嵌入的最远点采样。模型通过内聚能、力、应力及综合损失，在来自父分布的保留测试集和分布偏移的MP-r²SCAN测试集上进行评估。我们观察到幂律缩放改善……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在固定模型配置下系统研究了通用机器学习原子间势（M3GNet、MACE、PET）在多种数据采样策略和分布偏移测试集下的数据缩放行为，观察到幂律缩放并探讨了此类缩放定律是否具有普适性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates data scaling of universal MLIPs (M3GNet, MACE, and PET) under fixed model configurations across multiple sampling strategies and distribution-shifted test sets, observing power-law scaling and probing whether such scaling laws are universal.
